skill gem]], which grants both '''Vaal Impurity of Ice''' and [[Purity of Ice]] skills. The vaal skill temporarily grants the caster and nearby [[Ally|allies]] [[cold]] maximum [[Resistance|cold resistance]], immunity to [[chill]] and [[freeze]], and causes their [[cold damage]] to ignore enemy [[Resistance|cold resistance]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== Contrary to what is written in the description, the skill no longer reduces the amount of [[cold damage]] taken, instead, it provides maximum [[Resistance|cold resistance]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Radius |c1_header = +x metres to radius |c1_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c1_pattern_value = +%sm |c2_abbr = Aura
